answer_1.quote: We propose CASE to align cognition and affection for responding empathetically... The task is empathetic response generation in dialogue.
answer_1.outputs: Empathetic dialogue responses generated by the model.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the widely used Perplexity (PPL) and Distinct-1/2 (Dist-1/2)... In the model's emotion classification evaluation, we measure the accuracy (Acc) of emotion prediction.

answer_4.quote: Three crowdsourcing workers are asked to choose the better one (Win) from two responses... we consider three aspects, respectively, i.e., (1) Coherence (Coh.), (2) Empathy (Emp.), (3) Informativeness (Inf.).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two responses and select which is better for coherence, empathy, and informativeness.
